observations: Photo 0: One wooden pallet on a concrete floor; light-colored timber; visible nail heads/screws; no obvious cracks from this angle.
Photo 1: Another angle of the same wooden pallet; top deck boards and stringers visible; pallet appears intact.
Photo 2: Close-up showing pallet underside/blocks; wood looks rough/used; no clear signs of rot from the visible areas.

claims.claim: Wooden pallets are the backbone of supply chain logistics, manufacturing, and warehousing, while...
claims.evidence: Seller’s general statement; photos only show a wooden pallet, not the broader claim.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added.
claims.evidence: Photos show a pallet on a clean floor, but cannot confirm dryness, whether any water was added, or whether it is 'sorted' by grade.

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning.
claims.evidence: No scale ticket/receipt or photo of the weighing is provided; photos show pallets but not the total quantity or the weighing process.

risks.risk: Quantity mismatch: seller claims a total weight (500 kg) but photos show only pallets; could be fewer pallets than implied, affecting value.
risks.proof: A photo/video of the certified scale reading with the full load (showing the total weight) and/or a count of pallets included.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a single used wooden pallet (worst case for value).

risks.risk: Condition/hidden damage: photos may not show worm holes, rot, or structural weakness that affects load-bearing.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all 4 corners and underside blocks, plus a quick flex/press test video showing no wobble.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used pallet with unknown load-bearing condition (worst case).

risks.risk: Moisture/odor: 'dry' claim can’t be confirmed remotely; wet pallets can lead to damage and rejection.
risks.proof: Moisture meter reading (photo of meter + reading) or a short video showing no dampness/odor indicators.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed dry (worst case).

risks.risk: Treatment/chemical safety: pallets may be treated (e.g., fumigated) or contaminated; photos don’t show markings clearly.
risks.proof: Clear photo of any stamp/marking on the pallet (e.g., IPPC/HT/MB) and a close-up of the wood surface.
risks.if_unproven: Price without any safety/treatment guarantee (worst case).

proof_requests: Photo/video of the certified scale showing the total weight and what pallets are on it (to verify the 500 kg claim).
Count of pallets included (or show all pallets together in one frame).
Clear close-ups of pallet stamps/markings (if any) and all corners/underside blocks.
Moisture meter reading or evidence of dryness (photo of meter + reading).
response.reason: The photos confirm a wooden pallet, but the key pricing driver is the seller’s claimed total weight/quantity (500 kg) and condition guarantees, which are not verifiable from the provided images.
